title: Idaho Supreme Court dismisses challenge to 100-slip Spokane River marina plan
summary_full: In a significant legal ruling, the Idaho Supreme Court dismissed a community's challenge to a marina expansion project, finding that four residents had not properly engaged in the necessary administrative procedures. Their public remarks alone were deemed insufficient for legal standing to contest the permit granted by the Department of Lands. This decision underscores the importance of following procedural guidelines to effectively challenge state agency rulings in Idaho.
